How to apply

  1. Step 1 Explore the programme

    Visit with your family and ask what you can build in the course you’re considering.

  2. Step 2 Contact admissions

    Tell the team what you’d like to study and ask for the formal application instructions.

  3. Step 3 Check eligibility

    Check the marks, entrance scores and documents required for your chosen programme.

  4. Step 4 Review your offer

    Review the formal offer and fees before accepting a seat.
